title: Web: Home weight
description: The `weight` part of web_home, as it stood that day: the latest weigh-in on or before the day (the main number when its date is the day), the weekly rate (7-day trend minus the trend 7 days earlier) judged against the active phase's band for that phase week, and the 7-day trend over the 14 days ending the day. The trend value and the band itself are in the weight detail only.

weigh_in.description: The most recent weigh-in on or before the day; null when there is none. outlier: marked by the sync (left out of the trend).

weekly_rate_kg.description: kg per week; null with too few weigh-ins.

vs_band.description: As the weekly check-in judges a week: not_evaluated while any of the 7 days is in the glycogen window; null without a rate, before a phase or without a band.

series.description: The 14 days ending the day, oldest first: the 7-day trend each day (null with too few weigh-ins).
